channel.description: Daily tech opinions digest for Yun Zhou

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: AI R&D Is Accelerating Towards Potential RSI in 2027
item.description: Reading METR's report: Anthropic's AI capabilities are improving about twice as fast as in 2024-25, mostly because AI is doing the R&D — a naive extrapolation puts full recursive self-improvement under a year away, with no clear bottlenecks in sight.

item.title: SemiAnalysis: We Visited China's Stargate in Inner Mongolia
item.description: A field visit to Envision's 800MW Galaxy campus in Ulanqab: first 120MW phase delivered in a year at a fifth of US costs, wind-powered, with 800V DC running straight to the rack — a reference point for where the US datacenter roadmap is headed.

item.title: Bruce Schneier: AI Security
item.description: Short framing from the [un]prompted conference: AI security splits into three — security of AI, security with AI, and security from AI — and researchers need to be clear which one they're working on.
